Upstream: https://github.com/RoutingKit/RoutingKit
Vendored:  subset (Contraction Hierarchy only) — the files under include/ and
           src/ are a subset of upstream master, enough to build and query a
           ContractionHierarchy. OSM import, nested dissection, customizable
           CH, GeoPositionToNode, etc. are intentionally NOT vendored.

No local modifications are known. If you edit a vendored file, record it in the
"Modifications" section below so future syncs don't silently clobber it.

To resync against upstream:
  1. Pick an upstream commit and record its hash below.
  2. Copy the kept files (see list) from upstream include/routingkit and src.
  3. Leave LICENSE in place.
  4. Rebuild and run tests/test_routingkit_ch.py.

Upstream commit: (unknown — initial vendor predates this record; please fill in
                  the next time the vendored sources are synced)

Files vendored (relative to third_party/routingkit/):
  LICENSE
  include/routingkit/*.h   (CH + supporting headers as of vendor time)
  src/*.cpp                (CH + supporting sources as of vendor time)

Modifications from upstream:
  None recorded.
